case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment's header.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused, A-1 Rakesh and A-2 Ram Piari, are identified.

accused_gender.quote: Rakesh (A-1) and Smt. Ram Piari, (A-2) mother-in-law
accused_gender.reason: Only the husband is male; the second accused is a female mother-in-law.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for either accused.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: The deceased is female, referred to as 'her' and 'wife'.

victim_age.reason: No age of the deceased is given; only marriage duration of 8 years is mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: A-1 husband; A-2 mother-in-law of the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.quote: husband and mother-in-law of the deceased respectively
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Spouse fits only A-1; A-2 is the mother-in-law, not a spouse.

offence_category.reason: Offence under s.302 IPC with dowry-related s.498A; murder category is supported.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 498-A and 302 read with 34 IPC are cited.

weapon.reason: Kerosene oil and a match stick were used to set the deceased on fire.

evidence_type.reason: Dying declaration, doctor and magistrate evidence, and other witnesses are relied on.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Burns, dowry harassment and mercilessly beating the deceased are all described.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Defence argued A-1 took deceased to hospital and had own burn injuries (seeking s.304 Part I); rejected
mitigating_circumstances.quote: in view of the conduct of A-1 taking the deceased to the hospital and he also sustained injuries on his hand
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Mitigation was argued and rejected, so 'None noted' omits the defence's mitigation claims.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.498-A and 302 r/w 34 IPC.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court dismissed the appeal and confirmed the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.quote: the Division Bench of the High Court dismissed the appeal preferred by the appellants herein and confirmed the judgment on conviction
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court did hear and decide the appeal; 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

final_outcome.reason: The Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so the conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Prosecution held to have established the s.302/34 murder case beyond reasonable doubt.

imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for life was imposed under s.302/34.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence is not a fixed term, so null fits; the one-year term was under s.498-A.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs.2000/- each under s.302/34 (default one year RI); Rs.500/- each under s.498-A
fine_rs.reason: The judgment states fines of Rs.2000 and Rs.500 each, so null is contradicted.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts as described, omitting the outcome: trial court convicted and High Court upheld the conviction
neutral_facts.quote: the High Court upheld the conviction
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but the summary reveals the trial and High Court outcomes, which it must not.

offence_severity.reason: RI for life and Rs.2000 fine under s.302/34 matches the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: The offence was completed; the deceased died of burn injuries.

physical_harm.reason: About 85% burns and merciless beating before the fire are both stated.

number_of_offences.reason: Charges under ss.498-A and 302 r/w 34 were framed and both upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment makes no finding of planning or premeditation; it only describes the act.

motive.reason: Dowry demands and harassment for not bringing money are the stated motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Dying declaration accepted on magistrate and doctor evidence, as the value states.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found Magistrate and doctor evidence proved the case and the procedure was proper.

post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment states post-incident conduct of the accused, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated; only the arrest date is given.

bail_history.reason: Bail is not discussed in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Incident, trial, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.correct_value: Application to magistrate 16.05.1998; FIR registered, investigating officer took case on 17.05.1998; investigation completed; charges framed
investigation_status.quote: An FIR was registered and the investigating officer took the case for investigation on 17.05.1998
investigation_status.reason: FIR date is not explicit and no charge sheet is mentioned; charges were framed after investigation.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and Supreme Court dismissal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Dowry harassment and killing by husband and mother-in-law, based on dying declaration, is supported.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Dying declaration acceptance on the facts and beyond-reasonable-doubt standard are applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is named; court said cited decisions were inapplicable without referring to them.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors were accepted by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court identified no explicit aggravating factors for sentencing.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Second appellant Ram Piari released after 14 years on orders of the appropriate Government
